title: Derived internal Hom from a pseudo-coherent module preserves bounded-below quasi-coherence
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-algebra which is pseudo-coherent as an $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], and let $K$ be an object of $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Then $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(A,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], with its natural $A$-module structure [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module], belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(A)$ [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra]; after forgetting the $A$-module structure it belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.

proof.text: Apply the pseudo-coherent clause of rhom_supported_quasiCoherent to the degree-zero object of A and K. This yields quasi-coherent cohomology and local lower bounds of the underlying internal Hom. This is the existing affine-local proof of Stacks 0A6H, reused as a tool.

Apply derivedLocallyBoundedBelowGlobal to the local bounds on the Noetherian scheme. Use the natural isomorphism derivedRHomAlgebraModule_underlying at K to transport quasi-coherence degree by degree and the vanishing below the global bound, using DerivedCategory.isGE_iff.
Apply derivedAlgebraQCohOfUnderlying to the resulting underlying quasi-coherence and bound, and combine this algebra-membership conclusion with the two underlying conclusions.

proof_origin.note: Reuse the existing general RHom lemma; prove uniformity and exact scalar restriction separately, without new holes.
